response.sql: WITH acc AS (SELECT t.account_id, d.A3 AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_flow, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, net_flow, txn_count, net_flow * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(net_flow) FROM acc) AS share FROM acc ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
